methodology.kind: performance pilot, not a release gate or superiority claim
methodology.ordering: paired serial measurements, engine order alternates; all outliers retained
methodology.timing: worker-reported execution plus full filesystem snapshot and assertions; fresh filesystem/shell setup and worker transport excluded
methodology.isolation: persistent dedicated engine workers; fresh shell and memory filesystem per sample; host load not controlled
methodology.correctnessGate: every sample checks complete stdout/stderr bytes, exit status, and regular-file bytes; failed workloads have null verifiedLatency
limitations: no remote or real filesystem timing
